mapper.select: SELECT ml.ID AS MISSION_LOG_ID, ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS ASSIGNMENT_ID, mi.TITLE AS MISSION_TITLE, dma.CHALLENGE_ID AS CHALLENGE_ID, ml.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, me.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, ml.SUBMIT_CONTENT AS SUBMIT_CONTENT, ml.ATTACHMENT_URL AS ATTACHMENT_URL, ml.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC, ml.STATUS AS STATUS, ml.REVIEWED_BY AS REVIEWED_BY, ml.REJECT_REASON_CODE AS REJECT_REASON_CODE, ml.REWARD_AMOUNT AS REWARD_AMOUNT, ml.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM MISSION_LOG ml JOIN DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma ON dma.ID = ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID JOIN MISSION mi ON mi.ID = dma.MISSION_ID JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = ml.MEMBER_ID WHERE ml.ID = #{id}

FROM MISSION_LOG WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC

SELECT
FROM MISSION_LOG WHERE ASSIGNMENT_ID = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID

SELECT
FROM MISSION_LOG WHERE STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, ID DESC

SELECT ml.ID AS MISSION_LOG_ID, ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS ASSIGNMENT_ID, mi.TITLE AS MISSION_TITLE, dma.ASSIGNED_DATE AS ASSIGNED_DATE, ml.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, me.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, ml.STATUS AS STATUS, ml.REVIEWED_BY AS REVIEWED_BY, ml.REWARD_AMOUNT AS REWARD_AMOUNT, ml.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(ml.SUBMIT_CONTENT, 100, 1) AS SUBMIT_CONTENT_PREVIEW FROM MISSION_LOG ml JOIN DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma ON dma.ID = ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID JOIN MISSION mi ON mi.ID = dma.MISSION_ID JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = ml.MEMBER_ID WHERE dma.CHALLENGE_ID = #{challengeId} AND (#{assignedDate} IS NULL OR dma.ASSIGNED_DATE = #{assignedDate}) AND (#{memberId} IS NULL OR ml.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AND (#{cursor} IS NULL OR ml.ID < #{cursor}) ORDER BY ml.ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MISSION_LOG (MEMBER_ID, ASSIGNMENT_ID, SUBMIT_CONTENT, ATTACHMENT_URL, REWARD_AMOUNT, IS_PUBLIC, STATUS, REVIEWED_BY, REJECT_REASON_CODE, COMPLETED_AT) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{assignmentId}, #{submitContent}, #{attachmentUrl}, #{rewardAmount}, #{isPublic}, #{status}, #{reviewedBy}, #{rejectReasonCode}, #{completedAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT dma.ASSIGNED_DATE AS ACTIVITY_DATE, c.ID AS CHALLENGE_ID, c.TITLE AS CHALLENGE_TITLE, me.THEME_COLOR AS THEME_COLOR, COUNT(*) AS MISSION_COUNT, NVL(SUM(tx.NET_AMOUNT), 0) AS REWARD_AMOUNT FROM MISSION_LOG ml JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = ml.MEMBER_ID JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.ID = me.CHALLENGE_ID JOIN DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma ON dma.ID = ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID
LEFT JOIN (SELECT MISSION_LOG_ID, SUM(AMOUNT) AS NET_AMOUNT FROM TRANSACTIONS GROUP BY MISSION_LOG_ID) tx ON tx.MISSION_LOG_ID = ml.ID WHERE me.USER_ID = #{userId} AND dma.ASSIGNED_DATE BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY dma.ASSIGNED_DATE, c.ID, c.TITLE, me.THEME_COLOR ORDER BY dma.ASSIGNED_DATE, c.ID

SELECT ml.ID AS MISSION_LOG_ID, c.ID AS CHALLENGE_ID, c.TITLE AS CHALLENGE_TITLE, me.THEME_COLOR AS THEME_COLOR, mi.TITLE AS MISSION_TITLE, dma.ASSIGNED_DATE AS ASSIGNED_DATE, ml.STATUS AS STATUS, ml.REVIEWED_BY AS REVIEWED_BY, ml.REWARD_AMOUNT AS REWARD_AMOUNT, ml.IS_PUBLIC AS IS_PUBLIC FROM MISSION_LOG ml JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = ml.MEMBER_ID JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.ID = me.CHALLENGE_ID JOIN DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma ON dma.ID = ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID JOIN MISSION mi ON mi.ID = dma.MISSION_ID WHERE me.USER_ID = #{userId} AND dma.ASSIGNED_DATE = #{date} ORDER BY c.ID

SELECT DISTINCT dma.ASSIGNED_DATE FROM MISSION_LOG ml JOIN MEMBER me ON me.ID = ml.MEMBER_ID JOIN DAILY_MISSION_ASSIGNMENT dma ON dma.ID = ml.ASSIGNMENT_ID WHERE me.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY 1 DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
